ideas.pitch: A predictive spatial-temporal intelligence platform that forecasts congestion and optimizes micro-mobility routes around Orlando entertainment corridors using Poisson regression and real-time transit data.
ideas.title: Orlando Tourist Crowd Flow & Micro-Mobility Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact pattern of the AI Forecasting Hackathon winner by applying rigorous statistical modeling rather than a generic UI wrapper, appealing to judges looking for hard data science.

ideas.pitch: An automated satellite and aerial monitoring tool for local environmental compliance, tracking canopy cover and urban heat islands using computer vision and GIS spatial indexing.
ideas.title: Campus Green Space Compliance & Heatmap Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Emulates the runner-up Xcelerate Hackathon winner by focusing on real-world industrial and municipal land compliance monitoring.

ideas.pitch: A localized dining hall and budget-grocery AI nutrition assistant that generates hyper-personalized meal plans based on local student budgets and dietary restrictions.
ideas.title: Student Health and Nutritional AI Concierge
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the winning formula of the Mealzy 24-Hour Hackathon by solving an immediate, relatable daily problem for college students with a polished user experience.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace where student freelancers securely execute and settle micro-tasks using USDC escrow smart contracts.
ideas.title: Decentralized Campus Micro-Task Escrow Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the Synthesis Hackathon winning archetype by combining autonomous agents with real financial settlement on Base.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent student success platform combining localized RAG and personalized AI tutors to route academic questions to the right departmental resources.
ideas.title: Campus Multi-Agent Academic Support Network
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly adapts the winning architecture from the GreenNovation Hackathon by implementing a specialized multi-agent student support workflow.
